title: Derivative of a logarithmic hyperbolic-sine difference
statement: For each real number $u>0$, the function $q\mapsto \bigl(\log(\sinh(u/q))-\log(\sinh(u-u/q))\bigr)/2$ is differentiable at $q=2$, with derivative $-u\cosh(u/2)/(4\sinh(u/2))$.
replaced: For every $u>0$, the real function $q\mapsto\tfrac12[\log\sinh(u/q)-\log\sinh(u-u/q)]$ has derivative $-u\cosh(u/2)/(4\sinh(u/2))$ at $q=2$.
